text:
sam.k: Heads up — ops requested a proposal for per-model burst behavior. Current burst is per-key tokens and it's getting gamed by lots of tiny fast models. We need a fairer per-model-family/band strategy. thoughts?

marta: Totally. My quick take: compute a stable 'unit cost' per model family and charge bursts against credits using that unit. e.g., small-llm=0.5, base-llm=1, large-llm=3. That prevents small cheap models from chewing big bursts.

ari_engineer: Prefer a deterministic compute_units table we maintain in the catalog (no on-the-fly heuristics). Keep math simple: request_cost = compute_units * ceil(tokens/256). Then quota checks done on units, not raw tokens.

luke_oncall: Need to avoid sudden 429 storms during deploys. Can we support a short soft-burst overdraft with exponential decay rather than hard-block immediately? also: surface per-model burst usage in alerts.

elena_pm: For Console: show both raw token quota and normalized "effective units" per model for each API key/org. Add a small UX to let org admins allocate a shared burst pool across model families. Show projected cost impact when they adjust sliders.

infra-bot: deploy-check: per-model-quota-service on staging passed integration tests. Metric names added: quota.per_model.units_consumed and quota.per_model.overdraft_count

ari_engineer: small config sketch for API telemetry (headers are only for insight, server computes authoritative units):
```
POST /v1/generate
Headers:
  Authorization: Bearer <key>
  X-Client-Request-Id: <id>
Body:
  { model: "redwood/gpt-4-medium", prompt: "..." }
Server computes compute_units from catalog and returns:
  X-Compute-Units-Charged: 4
```

marta: +1 — don't let clients set units. Also we need per-key soft vs hard thresholds: soft_credits allow brief overdraft, hard_credits block. Decay window config: e.g., overdraft_decay_seconds = 300.

luke_oncall: Also propose fallback routing: if model family quota is exhausted, automatically route to pinned cheaper variant in same family (if org allows). That reduces 429s and preserves UX. Need clear headers so apps know a fallback happened.

sam.k: Important security note: compute_units must be computed server-side to avoid spoofing. Headers are informative only. Also add audit logs for automatic fallbacks and overdrafts.

elena_pm: I'll mock the console flows and a short admin API to set family_weights and fallback preferences. Who wants to own rollout? We should stagger by region and enable feature flag per org.

ari_engineer: I can take rollout and telemetry. Plan: backfill compute_unit values for existing catalog models, enable read-only telemetry for 1 week, then enable soft overdraft in non-prod, then soft in prod for 10% of orgs, then expand. I'll open an RFC with migration steps.

luke_oncall: One more: cap carryover of unused burst credits (prevent infinite accumulation). propose max_carryover = 2x monthly allocation.

sam.k: Great. Can someone open a PR with RFC + config examples + SRE runbook for 429 spike mitigation? I'll coordinate with Legal for any customer notices. :thumbsup:

elena_pm: I'll start the mockups and draft the admin API. tagging @ari_engineer to sync on telemetry fields.

ari_engineer: on it — will add quota metrics and an early-warning alert for family-overdraft-rate > 0.5% per minute.

sam.k: Thanks team. We'll reconvene after the RFC PR.
